title: TCP Trace Generator
description: TCP Trace Generator is a Python/Scapy teaching tool that simulates a TCP connection with Reno or Tahoe congestion control and writes both a pcap capture of the exchanged segments and a CSV log of the sender's internal state (cwnd, ssthresh, RTO). Its discrete-time classroom mode produces clean, predictable traces that students can analyse by hand in computer networks courses.
notes: This work has been supported by the teaching innovation project UAH/EV1827, "Hacia una Integración Crítica y Ética de la Inteligencia Artificial Generativa en el Aprendizaje en 'Laboratorio de Redes, Sistemas y Servicios'", funded by the Universidad de Alcalá (Proyectos de Innovación Docente 2026).
